data_basis: Previously downloaded current-season nflverse and Kalshi snapshots; no new subscription, source, or automatic refresh. The HTTP audit used only disposable storage.

calculation_rules.headline: Equal-weight mean of verified team-game yards allowed; #1 is fewest; exact competition ties
calculation_rules.supporting: Targets/receptions or carries per game, total opportunities, season-total yards/opportunities, season-total touchdowns
calculation_rules.scope: Current-season completed regular-season games including overtime
calculation_rules.qb: Official rushing total; designed-run/scramble/kneeldown components only where every QB yards and carries reconcile with play-by-play
calculation_rules.missing: Unavailable/conflicting games excluded and flagged; verified zeroes included; zero-opportunity efficiency unavailable
calculation_rules.positions: Each player-game row; RB and FB grouped
calculation_rules.league: Equal weight per available team season value; missing and incomplete data flagged
calculation_rules.unidentified_rows: Ignore only records lacking name, ID and position with all seven relevant fields explicitly zero; report each exclusion and still reconcile team totals

checks: current overall and position ranks together
combined props retain two separate position ranks
partial QB play-by-play withholds breakdown only
http.database_safety: Only a disposable database and ephemeral localhost port were used. User database and running app were untouched.

limitations: Position-group totals do not predict one individual player's output.
No opponent-strength adjustment or minimum sample cutoff.
Position/statistic combinations outside the five approved categories retain overall defense context.
Unverified QB breakdowns remain unavailable even when official rushing totals are available.
